messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads up — candidate for SRE IC3 has a calendar conflict. Interview block currently 9:30–10:30 PT, but panelist A needs to drop at 9:50. Can someone cover the last 20m or switch slot?
Sam (Eng): I can backfill 9:50–10:30, happy to take the handoff.
Elena (Hiring): Thanks Sam. Quick Q: should you pick up the system-design portion or just the debrief note-taking? We usually keep the same score owner for tech sections.
Sam (Eng): I can take system-design questions and score them. I'll also capture notes in the debrief doc.
Kevin (Infra): FYI candidate is in CET, so their availability window is tight — we scheduled early PT on purpose. Confirming start times: invite shows 9:30 PT / 18:30 CET.
Priya (People Ops): Good catch Kevin. Elena — wanted to confirm rubric weights so Sam knows scoring anchors. Current guide is: tech 60, infra-design 25, role-fit 15.
Elena (Hiring): That's right. For this role, bump infra-design to 30 and reduce fit to 10. Add a 5-point buffer for deployment troubleshooting (very relevant).
Maya (People Ops): I'll update the rubric doc link in the invite and add a note: "Sam assigned as alternate score owner for last 40m". Also adding debrief checklist: 1) consensus anchor, 2) must-have blockers, 3) score summary.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder — update candidate panel metadata within 15m to avoid double-book conflicts.
Sam (Eng): Got it. Where should I jot notes? Link the debrief doc and I'll paste highlights: https://docs.internal/redwood/debriefs/sre-ic3-0426 (please ensure access)
Priya (People Ops): Shared access to that doc now. One last operational ask — if Sam finds the candidate didn't get full system-design time, mark "partial" in the debrief and flag for follow-up interview.
Sam (Eng): Will do. Also pinging @Kevin if any infra-specific logs/questions need to be ready.
Kevin (Infra): I'll have a tiny debug snippet ready (5–10 lines) and a short customer-case prompt. If Sam wants, I can drop it into the doc before the interview starts.
Elena (Hiring): Awesome. Priya — can you update the calendar title to include "(split coverage)" and add a 5-min transition buffer in the invite so the handoff is explicit?
Priya (People Ops): Done — added buffer and updated title. Also added a thread in the invite with the rubric bullets and who owns which section.
Sam (Eng): Cool. I'll own infra-design + notes. If anything changes, I'll post here. :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): Post-interview: please add raw scores as separate lines (no discussion in the doc) to make aggregation simpler. Then schedule 20-min debrief within 2 business days.
Sam (Eng): Copy that.
Priya (People Ops): Closing the loop — coverage confirmed, rubric adjusted, doc shared, calendar updated. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
